title: Troubleshooting for ANTI-THEFT SYSTEM
ocr_text:
Troubleshooting for ANTI-THEFT SYSTEM

Turn ignition key from LOCK position to ACC position.

Display A showing? → No → Radio switch turned ON.
↓ Yes
ID number is set. → Display B showing? → No → ID number not input. (Display D)
                      ↓ Yes
While "A" is displayed hold and push 6 buttons in. Push and hold the "PWR VOL" knob. Check display. → Display B → Refer to each malfunction item.
                                                                                    → Display E → ANTI-THEFT SYSTEM operating condition. (ID number input error 5 times) Take to designated radio service station.

"SEC" display disappears after 1 second. → Yes →
↓ No
ANTI-THEFT SYSTEM operating condition. (ID number input error 4 times or less) → Normal operation when radio switch turned ON. → Yes → Forgot to press switch.
                                                                                   ↓ No
Input ID number, check display. ← Cancel ID number, refer to each malfunction item.

After 2 seconds
Display D   Display A or B   Display C → A

ANTI-THEFT SYSTEM not cancelled. ID number input 5 times or more? → No
↓ Yes
Take to designated radio service station.

ANTI-THEFT SYSTEM cancelled. Check audio system again. → OK → ID number not input, or else input error.
↓ NG
Cancel ID number, refer to each malfunction item.
